speaker.name: Model Monica
speaker.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

output.objection: I need the registry to automate every deployment step so I can trace exactly which model version produced each forecast. The current plan leaves too much manual logging for me to rely on it for reproducibility.
output.correction: I am not asking for a human approval gate on every model push, but I do need the tooling to handle the versioning and metadata automatically. Please file this under automation, not governance, because the issue is the lack of tooling, not the lack of review.
